Your standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is Mondays at 13:45. It's for the Corvid rollout. You told me this in our DM on Oct 14 and asked me to remember it, and I've replied to you in the DM with that answer.

In my first reply I also said the call wasn't on your calendar. That was wrong: the calendar I checked was mine, not yours, so I can't tell whether it's on yours. I sent a second message correcting it.
